editorial:
Imagine you are stuck in a freezing mountain blizzard at a lonely rest stop with a few strangers. You are already on edge because you are trying to stay sober and get your life back together. Then, you look out the window and see a little girl locked in a van in the parking lot. Now you know one of the people inside the building is a kidnapper, but you have no idea who. The vibe is super tense from the start, making you feel the pressure as the characters start turning on each other. It is a cat-and-mouse game where nobody can be trusted, and the snowy setting makes you feel trapped with no way out.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing. The acting is solid, and the twists keep the story moving fast so you never get bored. While some of the plot choices feel a bit convenient, the action scenes are exciting enough to make you overlook it. If you love a good mystery, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out that the kidnapper is actually the woman who seemed the most helpful. After a big fight in the snow, the main character manages to outsmart her and save the little girl. The kidnapper is finally stopped, and the police arrive just in time to take her away. It wraps up with the main character finding some peace and strength after surviving the nightmare and doing the right thing.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves twisty mysteries and high-tension survival stories.
